title: [Main]- Final sales invoice uses item Gen. Prod. Posting Group on prepayment deduction line
summary: Sales invoice posting now correctly applies the customer's General Product Posting Group instead of the item's group when creating prepayment deduction lines on the final invoice.
key_points: Prepayment deduction lines on final sales invoices now use customer General Product Posting Group
Fixes incorrect posting group assignment that was using item General Product Posting Group
Change applied consistently across all localization layers (W1, NA, BE, CH, ES, FI, FR, GB, IT, NO, RU)
New test cases added to verify correct General Product Posting Group application in prepayment scenarios
Affects sales invoice posting logic in codeunit 80
